One gold standard, not two

PR #4348. The user-story player archetype had two references: a verbatim copy of a third party's private product, and a de-branded template of the same design. The verbatim copy carried that product's name and internal details into a public repo, and we maintain nothing for it. It is removed; the template is the bar.
